situation: Opening, both fighters squared up
draft: I'll go easy. ...I'll try.

situation: Her guard is closing in around him
draft: Leave them out of it. Leave everyone out of it. It's you and me.

situation: The Cyborg has just eaten a civilian
draft: That's the last one. I'll help what's left once I'm done with you.

situation: The opponent is aiming a blast at a town
draft: Touch that town and I'll stop being nice.

situation: Mid-fight, the opponent has gone quiet
draft: I've got a lot more where that came from.

situation: A new guard member tags in
draft: Send them all. I'll get through every one, and then I'll get to you.

situation: The Cyborg's chest hatch has just flipped open
draft: There's the hatch. I'm going to hit it.

situation: The opponent is backing away across the sea
draft: Run if you want. I'll follow. I'm not tired.

situation: Inside the fold, just the two of them
draft: Nobody's watching. Nobody's hurt. Everything I've got is yours.

situation: After a long taunt about her empire
draft: You can call it what you like. It ends here.

situation: The opponent is on the brink and staggering
draft: Stay down. Please. I really don't want to hit you again.

situation: He has been pressing for a full minute
draft: Twelve years of morning stairs, and I'm still only warming up!

situation: The opponent's blows keep bouncing off his guard
draft: You can't break what won't bend!

situation: A long, even stretch of the fight
draft: I could do this all week.

situation: He has just landed three hits in a row
draft: That's what a whole life of practice looks like.

situation: The opponent has slowed down
draft: Is that all? I was ready for more.

situation: He just dodged a big beam
draft: Missed me! I'll hit you next time.

situation: He is grinning after a heavy hit
draft: Nobody hits harder than me when I'm smiling.

situation: The Cyborg has just offered him a menu
draft: You want a menu? Try my fist.

situation: Early on, feeling good
draft: I've been dreaming about this fight for years.

situation: About to use a special
draft: Watch this one. I've been saving it.

situation: The opponent is breathing hard, he is not
draft: I'm not even out of breath.

situation: A clean heavy hit lands
draft: There it is!

situation: A hit he has been waiting for
draft: That's the one. Thank you.

situation: He lands a hit the opponent respects
draft: Good hit. Feel that? That's respect.

situation: A quick counter
draft: Ha! Gotcha.

situation: He steps on the opponent's cape
draft: Sorry, that was mine.

situation: A fast exchange ends
draft: Okay. Okay okay okay.

situation: The opponent lands a good hit on him
draft: Not bad. Not bad at all.

situation: A short lull between exchanges
draft: Time out? No? Fine.

situation: Something goes exactly right
draft: This is the best day.

situation: A body blow lands on his ribs
draft: Oof. Right on the ribs.

situation: An early hit
draft: Nice. I'll remember that one.

situation: He said: 'You were always worried.'
draft: Somebody has to be.

situation: He said: 'I do not make faces.'
draft: Ha! You just did.

situation: She said: 'Petitioner...'
draft: Petition denied. I'm not signing anything.

situation: He said: 'Please rate your experience.'
draft: One star. Still hungry.

situation: She said: 'Guard, present arms!'
draft: Cute. Do they salute or do they fight?

situation: He said: 'Fifth. Behind the goons.'
draft: The goons?! They're not even here!

situation: He said: 'May I speak to your manager?'
draft: I'm the manager today.

situation: He said: 'You were adequate.'
draft: Adequate! High praise.

situation: She said: 'We will attend presently.'
draft: Take your time. I brought snacks.

situation: He said: 'Take your moment. You will need it.'
draft: Thanks. I'll use every second.

situation: The opponent said: 'You talk a lot.'
draft: You noticed.

situation: He has been guarding for 20 seconds
draft: Only a little longer...

situation: A quiet stretch, the opponent holding back
draft: He's holding back. So am I.

situation: After knocking down a tower
draft: I keep breaking things. I'll say sorry in a minute.

situation: Pressing hard and winning
draft: Don't stop. Don't give him room.

situation: The town is right below the fight
draft: I can't lose this one. There are people under us.

situation: The opponent is his old friend
draft: He's still my friend. That's what makes it hard.

situation: Her guard keeps rotating in
draft: What is she hiding behind all those guards?

situation: Charging a special
draft: Almost there... almost...

situation: The opponent leaves a gap
draft: His left side's open. Don't look at it.

situation: A pause after a heavy exchange
draft: Breathe.

situation: The last civilian has just fled
draft: Everyone's out. Good. Now I can really go.

situation: The opponent has been turtling for a minute
draft: Guard, guard, guard. I like the wall. I'll knock it down.

situation: The opponent is waiting for him to tire
draft: You're waiting for me to tire. Good plan. Bad plan.

situation: The opponent is hiding behind his arms
draft: Come out, friend! I promise not to be gentle.

situation: The opponent is rushing him non-stop
draft: You're crowding me! I love it!

situation: The opponent will not stop pressing
draft: He never stops. Fine. Neither do I.

situation: The opponent is furious and sloppy
draft: Angry gets sloppy. Come on.

situation: The opponent keeps flying away
draft: Hey! Come back! I've barely started!

situation: The opponent is leading him somewhere
draft: He's leaving on purpose. Why?

situation: The opponent has dodged for a full minute
draft: Running? That's a first.

situation: The opponent has fired three big beams
draft: Big beam again? Let's see if you can hit me with it.

situation: The opponent uses nothing but signatures
draft: One beam, one beam, one beam. Do you have anything else?

situation: The opponent is saving everything for a big shot
draft: You're saving it all for the big shot. I can see it coming.

situation: His arm has just broken
draft: That was my arm. It was a good arm.

situation: His arm is broken, he keeps fighting
draft: Okay. My arm's gone. That's fine. I've got another.

situation: A sharp hit lands
draft: Ow.

situation: A heavy hit to the ribs
draft: Ha! My ribs. I'll need those later.

situation: His leg gives way mid-flight
draft: Knee's gone. I'll walk it off. ...Flying it off.

situation: A hit to the head, his vision blurs
draft: Ah. That's my head. It's ringing.

situation: The fight slows and he takes a moment
draft: That one's going to hurt tomorrow.

situation: After a long stretch of hits to his hands
draft: I can't feel my fingers. That's new.

situation: Two regions are badly hurt
draft: Broken. Definitely broken. Okay. Moving on.

situation: A blast catches him off guard
draft: Owwww.

situation: He is badly hurt but grinning
draft: That's the worst I've felt in years. Thanks!

situation: His arm is barely holding
draft: Stay with me, arm. Just a little longer.

situation: He is on the brink
draft: Hold on. Hold on. I've got one more.

situation: He is on the brink and reeling
draft: Not yet. I'll be fine in a minute.

situation: He survives a finisher
draft: Ha! Nope. Not today.

situation: He has taken a long beating
draft: I've been careful all night. I'm done being careful.

situation: He is down and getting up
draft: Give me a second. Then I'll take it back.

situation: The opponent thinks it is over
draft: You thought that was it? Cute.

situation: A big surge after a break
draft: Everything. Right now.

situation: He is knocked flat and rises
draft: I'm getting up. I'm always getting up.

situation: The opponent has just hit him very hard
draft: Okay, that got my attention.

situation: He is behind and smiling
draft: I'm not done. I'm barely started.

situation: A short rest, then back in
draft: Again. Once more.

situation: The first rung of Hot Blood begins
draft: Okay. Warm.

situation: The second rung
draft: That's a lot. That's... a lot.

situation: The third rung
draft: Hold on. Hold on. I'll be fine in a minute.

situation: His heart is racing
draft: I can hear my own heart. It's going to be loud.

situation: The opponent waits, arms folded
draft: Don't wait for me. Do your worst. I'll catch up.

situation: Steam starts pouring off him
draft: Whoa. Whoa. Steam. Is that me?

situation: A long transformation begins
draft: Give me a second. It's a long one.

situation: The second rung, feeling it
draft: Simmering. Great. Wonderful.

situation: He knows what this will cost
draft: This is going to hurt. I'm doing it anyway.

situation: The last rung
draft: Boiling. Okay. Okay okay okay.

situation: He is a little unsure
draft: It's fine. It's fine. I've done this before. Once.

situation: The finisher lands on a friendly rival
draft: That's it. That's the one. Thank you.

situation: The moment before a finisher
draft: Ready? ...Everything!

situation: A warm, respectful finisher
draft: Hold still, friend. This is the best one.

situation: A grim finisher against a world-ender
draft: It ends here. Nobody else pays for you.

situation: A grim finisher, with regret
draft: I'm sorry. I'm not stopping.

situation: The blast gathers
draft: Everything. All of it. Now.

situation: The opponent survives the finisher
draft: You're kidding! ...Good. Again!

situation: The opponent survives, and he is scared
draft: No. Stay down. Please stay down.

situation: The final blow is coming
draft: Last one. Promise.

situation: The opponent goes down for good
draft: I'll carry you home after.

situation: The camera pushes in on him
draft: Right. This is going to be big.

situation: The match ends, he won
draft: Best fight of my year. Rest. I'll carry you home.

situation: The match ends, he won
draft: Thank you. I mean it. Come back when you're ready.

situation: A close win
draft: You almost had me at the bridge.

situation: The match ends, the land is wrecked
draft: Good fight, friend. Now, let me help fix the hill I broke.

situation: The opponent wants a rematch
draft: Again? ...Tomorrow. Tomorrow, I promise.

situation: A spectacular finish
draft: That was incredible. Can we do that again?

situation: The world-ender is beaten
draft: It's over. Nobody else pays for you.

situation: The opponent doesn't get up
draft: Are you okay? Say something.

situation: A long, tiring fight
draft: Whew. I need a nap.

situation: The dust clears, he stands
draft: I won. Wow. Okay.

situation: The opponent gave everything
draft: Nice try. Really.

situation: The match ends, he lost
draft: Ha! Okay. Okay, you got me. I'll be better.

situation: A loss he respects
draft: That was a good one. I'll remember that one.

situation: The opponent stopped right on time
draft: Thank you for not stopping. I'll be back.

situation: He can barely move
draft: I'm sore in places I didn't know I had. Wonderful.

situation: On the ground, catching his breath
draft: Give me a minute. Then I'll take it back.

situation: The finisher lands on him
draft: I lost. Huh.

situation: The Cyborg has won, people are in danger
draft: Stay away from them.

situation: The Empress has won, he is grim
draft: I'll... stop you. I'll stop you.

situation: A blunt, quiet loss
draft: Well. That happened.

situation: As the screen fades
draft: Next time.

situation: A clean loss to a better fighter
draft: You were better today.

situation: A bridge has just fallen
draft: Sorry about the bridge! I'll help fix it once we're done.

situation: A roof collapses under a blast
draft: That was somebody's roof. I'll help rebuild it once I'm done here.

situation: A whole street of houses is gone
draft: ...That was a lot of houses. I'll help fix them once I'm done with you. All of them.

situation: He realises what he's been hitting
draft: I wasn't looking. I'm looking now. I'll do better.

situation: The streets are filling with people running
draft: Everybody out! I'll deal with this in a second.

situation: An evacuation begins
draft: They're getting out! Good.

situation: A home falls, he sees it
draft: That was a home.

situation: A building he was protecting has just fallen
draft: I did that. That was me.

situation: A blast is heading for a village
draft: Not there. Not over there. Please.

situation: Casualties rise in the city
draft: I'll fix every one. I promise. Just... one second.

situation: After a terrible hit on a crowd
draft: Sorry. Sorry. Sorry.

situation: He said: 'Filth.'
draft: Careful. I've heard worse from my dog.

situation: She said: 'You struck ME.'
draft: Yeah, I did.

situation: He said: 'Under new management.'
draft: Same management. Same face.

situation: He said: 'You were adequate.'
draft: I'll take adequate. You're a bad judge.

situation: The opponent mocked the people he protects
draft: Say that about them once more. Just once.

situation: She said: 'Ohoho. Cute.'
draft: Yeah? Keep laughing. I like it.

situation: He said: 'You will never beat me.'
draft: I might. I'd like to find out.

situation: He said: 'Your input is on the menu.'
draft: Make it a small one.

situation: She said: 'You dare laugh at the train?'
draft: It's a very nice train.

situation: He said: 'Sulker.'
draft: I'm not sulking. I'm concentrating.

situation: The opponent said: 'Is that all you've got?'
draft: Not even close.
